subject: Isolated-Prem Deployment: Kit manifest, signature ledger & rollout window
messages:
From: Samira Qureshi <samira.qureshi@deltagrid.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: OliveTech Solutions <solutions@olivetech.com>
Date: 2028-03-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Delivery for isolated-prem deployment - signed bundle and manifest

Monica,

Thanks for the sync earlier. DeltaGrid is preparing to accept the sealed delivery for our isolated-prem deployment (secure rack at Site-7). We need Redwood to provide the following as part of acceptance:

- Signed image bundle (immutable tar) with detached signature(s)
- A CSV manifest listing checksums for each artifact and operator signature slots
- A readable signing ledger (PDF) that shows each signer and timestamp
- Chain-of-custody form the courier will sign on pickup/delivery

We are targeting a 2028-03-05 to 2028-03-07 acceptance window; final date will depend on the courier ETA and customs clearance. Please confirm you can provide the signed artifacts + a DocuSign authorization for our operations team.

Also include any HSM/KMS fingerprint details and a short checklist for on-site operators (what to verify before activation).

Samira
Samira Qureshi
Head of Infrastructure, DeltaGrid
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Samira Qureshi <samira.qureshi@deltagrid.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Delivery for isolated-prem deployment - signed bundle and manifest

Samira — thanks, we can meet that window. High-level plan below; attaching the initial signing ledger and manifest stub for review.

Plan (summary):
- We will provide a signed bundle (dg_signed-image-bundle_v1.2.tar.gz) + detached signature file and a machine-readable manifest (dg_manifest_v1.2.csv).
- Signing will be performed via our HSM (YubiHSM cluster, YH-3) with KMS fingerprint published in the ledger. Karthik will sign off on the thumbprint.
- Courier will pick up sealed media (encrypted SSD) from our secure dispatch; chain-of-custody form attached.
- Priyom will run a signing ceremony on 2028-03-02 09:00 PT, capture operator signatures, and export ledger PDF.
- We will send a DocuSign deployment authorization you can route to on-site ops.

Attachments: signing-ledger-20280301.pdf (draft), dg_manifest_v1.2.csv (stub)

Next steps:
1) Samira: confirm acceptance window final date (prefer a concrete day in the 3-day range).
2) Karthik: confirm KMS/HSM fingerprint text is acceptable for DeltaGrid's security review.
3) Priyom: run the signing ceremony and share final ledger + detached signature file by EOD 2028-03-02.

--
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-02T08:10:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Signing ceremony checklist & operator steps (DeltaGrid)

Monica / Karthik — prepping for the ceremony tomorrow 09:00 PT. Notes and checklist:

Ceremony steps (chronological):
- Confirm KMS thumbprint: 3x HSM operators confirm on console; Karthik to verify the published fingerprint matches DG security doc.
- Generate detached signature using multikey policy (HSM primary + backup signer).
- Produce signing-ledger-YYYYMMDD.pdf with UTC timestamps and operator email addresses.
- Export AES-256-GCM envelope for the SSD, label media with manifest index.
- Capture a short video (operator POV) and checksum snapshots (sha256) for the ledger entry.
- Encrypt transport manifest for courier and provide sealed QR manifest (opaque to courier until DG unwrap).

Risk notes:
- If KMS thumbprint mismatch: abort and rotate to backup signer; do not release media.
- Customs delay risk: recommend courier hold-insurance and rapid push of documents to DG customs contact.

Attachments to produce after ceremony: dg_signed-image-bundle_v1.2.tar.gz, dg_signed-image-bundle_v1.2.tar.gz.sig, signing-ledger-20280302.pdf, dg_manifest_v1.2.csv

I will upload artifacts to a short-lived S3 link (pre-signed) and share DocuSign link for the authorization.

Priyom
Priyom Das
Deployment Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Samira Qureshi <samira.qureshi@deltagrid.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: OliveTech Solutions <solutions@olivetech.com>, Courier Ops <ops@securecourier.net>
Date: 2028-03-02T15:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Delivery for isolated-prem deployment - signed bundle and manifest

Thanks — sounds good. DeltaGrid confirms the acceptance day for Site-7 as 2028-03-06. Two requests before we can proceed:

1) Please provide the hardened KMS fingerprint in the ledger and a short note on key residency (on-prem vs Redwood-managed HSM). Our compliance needs the KMS to be Redwood-managed but non-exportable from HSM.
2) We need the courier chain-of-custody template filled and digitally signed on pickup. Can SecureCourier confirm they will use the sealed label protocol (manifest QR on seal) and provide a pickup time by tomorrow EOD?

If those are satisfied we'll route the DocuSign authorization to our on-site ops lead and provision customs paperwork.

Samira
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Samira Qureshi <samira.qureshi@deltagrid.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Courier Ops <ops@securecourier.net>
Date: 2028-03-03T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Delivery for isolated-prem deployment - signed bundle and manifest

Samira — final confirmations below and links to artifacts:

- KMS/HSM: Signing performed on Redwood-managed HSM cluster (YubiHSM v3). The ledger contains the canonical thumbprint: HSM-FP: 03:ab:7c:9f:... (full thumbprint included in attached signing-ledger-20280302.pdf). Keys are non-exportable and held in Redwood HSM; private material never leaves the HSM.

- Artifacts: dg_signed-image-bundle_v1.2.tar.gz + dg_signed-image-bundle_v1.2.tar.gz.sig uploaded to a pre-signed S3 location: https://s3.redwood-internal.example/signed-artifacts/DG/dg_signed-image-bundle_v1.2.tar.gz (link expires 72h).

- Chain-of-custody: attached chain-of-custody-template.pdf is filled; SecureCourier (ops@securecourier.net) confirmed sealed label protocol and will send pickup ETA tomorrow.

- DocuSign: deployment authorization sent (link: https://docusign.com/placeholder/deploy-auth-3742). Please have your on-site ops sign before courier arrival.

Attachments sent: signing-ledger-20280302.pdf, dg_manifest_v1.2.csv, dg_signed-image-bundle_v1.2.tar.gz.sig, chain-of-custody-template.pdf, docusign-deployment-authorization.pdf

If you want, Jordan can join the acceptance call on 2028-03-06 at 10:00 PT to walk through verification steps.

Thanks — see you on the acceptance day.

--
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
